website.note: Pipeline page references advancing 'PH1 payload' as cornerstone of an ADC pipeline against multiple tumors; only image-based pipeline graphic, no asset-level phase / NCT detail disclosed publicly.

ctgov.note: All 9 Akari/Celsus-sponsored historical trials (nomacopan and predecessor compounds) are COMPLETED, TERMINATED, or WITHDRAWN. No active interventional studies.

Additional bifunctional ADC candidates from the Peak Bio platform — preclinical / discovery
excluded_legacy_terminated: Nomacopan — HSCT-TMA program suspended under May 2024 program prioritization / restructuring; legacy nomacopan trials COMPLETED or TERMINATED

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Following the November 2024 acquisition of Peak Bio and the May 2024 prioritization that suspended the nomacopan HSCT-TMA program, Akari is now focused entirely on its preclinical ADC platform (AKTX-101 lead asset). No active company-sponsored Phase 1/2/3 trials on any public registry as of the 2025 10-K filing.
